messages:
olga: dropped a new compact row variant that emphasizes SLO slider and keeps burst as a secondary control. frames: https://www.figma.com/file/new789/minislo-burst (panel D). goal: no more than one visual line per pool on desktop.
kevin: liking the emphasis on SLO. question: should the SLO be a small chip slider or a micro-graph? slider is more direct but might crowd the row.
anita: copy tweak: instead of 'SLO target' use 'Latency target (ms)'. also change 'Burst' label to 'Short burst' for consistency.
sarah: a11y notes: the SLO slider needs keyboard + step labels and an aria-describedby pointing to current p95 estimate. also small sliders at 12px need contrast checks. For burst, make sure the icon button has aria-label="Enable short burst for <pool>" and the popover is reachable by keyboard.
ravi: engineering constraints: if SLO edits change routing we need a confirm modal for customers with autoscale locked by policy. Also prefer saving slider changes on blur or after 500ms debounce. For burst, restore last-used quanta per pool in local storage so it's less surprising.
olga: UX: I'll try a micro-graph inline (sparkline) replacing numeric p95 to save space; slider tooltip shows exact ms. For compact row, burst becomes a 16px thunder icon with a 1px divider.
kevin: micro-graph is cool but ensure it has alt text / aria-label like 'p95 latency trend' and a concise tooltip. Also add small cost delta under the row when pool changes: 'est +$0.08/min' in muted text.
anita: can we add a tiny help link 'How SLO affects autoscaling' that opens a modal? customers always ask why adjusting SLO changes min. keep it non-intrusive, 12px link.
sarah: checklist for PR: 1) slider keyboard increments, 2) aria-live for immediate value changes, 3) focus order: min -> max -> SLO -> burst, 4) burst popover focus trap, 5) contrast >=4.5:1. I'll paste this into the ticket.
olga: great. I'll iterate and push v2 with the sparkline and saved burst quanta. aiming for a11y fixes + mobile touch targets by EOD. :rocket:
